#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int n, k, mod;
int factorials[250003], inverses[250003];
int memo[27][250003];

int get_lowbit(int x) { return x & (-x); }

int fast_power(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (long long)result * base % mod;
        base = (long long)base * base % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

void initialize() {
    factorials[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
        factorials[i] = (long long)factorials[i - 1] * i % mod;
    inverses[n] = fast_power(factorials[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i)
        inverses[i] = (long long)inverses[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
}

int recurse(int x, int s) {
    if (memo[x][s] != -1) return memo[x][s];
    if (s == 0) return memo[x][s] = (long long)factorials[n] * factorials[k] % mod * inverses[k - x] % mod;
    int remaining = s - get_lowbit(s);
    long long total = 0;
    for (int t = remaining; t; t = (t - 1) & remaining)
        total = (total + (long long)recurse(x + 1, t) * inverses[s - t] % mod) % mod;
    total = (total + (long long)recurse(x + 1, 0) * inverses[s] % mod) % mod;
    return memo[x][s] = total;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &k, &mod);
    initialize();
    int answer = fast_power(k, n);
    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        memset(memo, -1, sizeof(memo));
        answer = (answer - recurse(0, n) + mod) % mod;
    }
    printf("%d", answer);
    return 0;
}
